items.author: chocobomoshpit.bsky.social
items.context: i think that was the first video game i was able to buy on the day it came out. also got a GBA SP on the same day. in retrospect, that might be a top 5 gaming day for me now that i think about it?
items.text: A new game and a new handheld on release day, that's a day worth remembering.

items.author: jffro.bsky.social
items.context: And KOTOR? Mission was one of my first video game crushes. Also, you can't beat that twist. It's up there with Vader being Luke's father
items.text: Mission is a great companion, and that twist still lands. KOTOR holds up really well.

items.author: phoenix.omg.lol
items.context: genuinely heartbroken by the closing of BioWare. DA:O was my first real AAA game and my intro to "holy shit, video games can do this??" re: its storytelling. devastated for the production teams and so sad we won't ever get to see any more of thedas.
items.text: Dragon Age: Origins really was special. Its storytelling still holds up if you ever want to revisit it.
